notes: CONFIRMED on price and shape, with one caveat that decides the verdict. USD 55.00 a year / 12 = USD 4.58 a month, and the annual is exactly 10x the published USD 5.50 monthly, so the yearly cycle is '2 Months Free' rather than a first-term promo. CORRECTION after re-reading the existing record: the cart states 'Total When Renewing: 1 Year @ $55.00 USD', so the renewal equals the first payment and exposure is 1.00x, not 1.20x. The 1.20x figure applies only if the annual cycle is withdrawn entirely and the plan falls back to the USD 5.50 monthly list. Payment methods are not readable without registering: the Blesta cart renders '$0.00 USD' and 'Any applicable taxes will be calculated after you register or log in' for both pricing_id=1171 (monthly) and 1172 (yearly).
